basic_info.description: Welcome to 380-382 Day Street, a charming duplex ideally located in the heart of Noe Valley.  This tenant-occupied property presents a fantastic opportunity for investors looking to establish  a foothold in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.  The building features one dual-level 3-bedroom unit and one upper-level 2-bedroom unit. The  spacious lower unit could be well-suited for future owner-occupancy, while the upper 2-bedroom  unit oers additional income potential. Both units enjoy excellent natural light, functional layouts,  and timeless San Francisco charm.  Additional features include a 1-car garage, a lovely deck, and a beautifully landscaped yard  perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A brand new roof was installed in December 2023, providing  peace of mind and long-term value.  Located just steps from vibrant 24th Street, residents enjoy easy access to a variety of local cafes,  restaurants, boutiques, and grocery stores. Commuters will appreciate nearby Muni lines, tech  shuttle stops, and BART, making travel to downtown and Silicon Valley a breeze. The location  also offers quick access to major freeways and bike routes
